notice-am.md addresses members politely or in the plural throughout, with no informal singular forms
expectations.evidence: Plural address throughout (የተከበራችሁ, ካጋጠማችሁ, ደውሉልን, ትዕግሥታችሁ). No informal singular forms.

notes: Most assertions are non-discriminating: the baseline (same model, no skill) already converted the date to ጥቅምት 28 ቀን 2018 ዓ.ም., used ከጠዋቱ 3:00 ሰዓት, kept placeholders and fixed every SMS error. The skill's value shows in finer points the checks don't capture.

Notice: with the skill the run gave both calendars and both clocks (Gregorian date and 9:00 a.m. in brackets) and computed the dates with Intl; the baseline gave only the Ethiopian forms. Both flagged that 7 Nov 2025 is in the past.

UI strings: with the skill every string is polite (button ያስቀምጡ); the baseline used the familiar masculine imperative አስቀምጥ for the button while its sentences are polite. The baseline argues that is common in Amharic apps; this is a style call for a native speaker, and a candidate assertion once decided.
Proofreading: with the skill the author's wording was kept and further edits only suggested; the baseline rewrote the greeting and the closing thanks unasked (the only failed assertion).
Cost: the skill adds about 5.7k tokens and 9s per run (reading SKILL.md and, in one run, computing dates).
